summary: Implemented BlochBoundary support plus symmetry-aware boundary metadata and phase-aware runtime transforms across the public API, IR, compiler, kernels, runtime wrapper, and tests.
key_findings: `BlochBoundary` is now a first-class public boundary edge with `Boundary.bloch(...)`, strict both-sides validation, and explicit complex phase metadata derived from `bloch_vec`.
Boundary IR now distinguishes periodic, Bloch, and reflective axes, marks `requires_complex_fields`, and carries per-axis symmetry sign metadata for electric and magnetic field families.

Compiled boundary metadata now includes Bloch exchange kinds, per-face phase factors, active symmetry axes, and reusable symmetry transforms for future chunk-planning and reduced-domain exchange paths.

Boundary ghost updates now apply conjugate phase wrapping on minus Bloch faces and forward phase wrapping on plus faces, while separate helper transforms expose boundary-edge and symmetry remaps directly to runtime callers.
Focused validation passed with `PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests/test_boundaries.py tests/test_ir.py tests/test_containers.py` and `python -m compileall src/autofdtd`.

artifacts.description: Added `BlochBoundary`, public constructors, and boundary-pair validation rules.
Extended compiled boundary metadata with Bloch phase factors and symmetry-axis transforms.
Added typed Bloch and symmetry IR payloads plus boundary-spec lowering with complex-field requirements.
Implemented phase-aware Bloch ghost updates and reusable boundary/symmetry transform helpers.
Extended runtime boundary wrapper to compile symmetry metadata and expose transform helpers.
Added Bloch boundary, symmetry metadata, phase-transform, and runtime/IR coverage.
Recorded Bloch runtime behavior and symmetry-metadata decisions for later boundary tasks.

follow_up_notes: Absorbing-boundary tasks can now extend the existing `CompiledBoundarySpec` contract without redesigning periodic/Bloch/symmetry lowering. No multi-GPU smoke was attempted because this task only touched boundary metadata and local ghost-transform behavior.
